answer: Agents register in the oasis state tree only after an SGX/TPM zero-knowledge attestation binds a unique hardware key to measured code; the river hash anchor and meadow consensus contract reject reused measurements and replayed proofs. Forging an identity requires compromising a fresh enclave or physically provisioning distinct silicon, while admission bonds follow a quadratic O(N^2) curve and are irreversibly slashed on equivocation, making Sybil expansion superlinear.
